content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe failed you. PayPal rejected your account. Gumroad's fees crippled your profit margin. But what if you could deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, bypassing these restrictions and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-everything-you-need-6|COREMERCH guide to building]]-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-5|How to]] a business without borders? You can. COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) empowers you with a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-every|github]] Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments combo that's ready to deploy in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. And if you need more, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. But for now, let's focus on the free infrastructure that can liberate you from platform-dependent commerce.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with traditional e-commerce platforms is that they rely on centralized infrastructure that can be shut down or restricted at any moment. But what if you could build a digital store that's entirely self-contained, with its own payment and delivery pipeline that's not reliant on any single platform? COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) does exactly that, using GitHub Pages for hosting, Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This setup is not only free but also gives you full control over your digital store and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a few things. First, you'll need to sign up for a COREMERCH account and purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). Next, you'll need to choose a cryptocurrency for payment processing and set up a wallet to receive payments. You'll also need to create a Cloudflare Pages account and set up a domain name for your store. Don't worry, these steps are straightforward and will be covered in more detail below.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

One of the key benefits of COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is its automatic on-chain crypto payment verification using NOWPayments. This means that customers can pay for your digital products with their favorite cryptocurrency, and you'll receive the payment instantly. To set this up, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Apps Script backend, which is a straightforward process that will be covered in the next section.
With COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free and start selling digital products online instantly.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and transactions. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more advanced setup that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, which can handle large volumes of traffic and transactions. This setup also includes end-to-end testing and 30-day support, making it an ideal choice for businesses that need to scale quickly.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'How much does it cost to deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free?' The answer is: with COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), you can deploy a digital store on GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments for free. And if you need more, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more advanced setup that includes Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. Either way, you'll have a business without borders, with full control over your digital store and customer data.
NOWPayments allows customers to pay for digital products with their favorite cryptocurrency, and you'll receive the payment instantly and automatically verify transactions on-chain.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, check out COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or visit our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details. And if you're ready to get started, sign up for a COREMERCH account today and deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
